{{Short description|American mathematician}}
{{Orphan|date=August 2024}}

'''Ratnasingham Shivaji''' is an American mathematician, focusing on mathematics and mathematical ecology, currently the H. Barton Excellence Professor<ref>{{Cite web |title=Friends with Math |url=https://app-p-researchmagazine.azurewebsites.net/spring-2023/friends-with-math/ |access-date=2026-06-29 |website=UNCG Research Magazine |language=en-US}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=https://sites.google.com/view/ratnasingham-shivaji |title=Ratnasingham Shivaji |publisher=uncg.edu |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref> at [[University of North Carolina at Greensboro]] and formerly a W. L. Giles Distinguished Professor at [[Mississippi State University]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.giles.msstate.edu/directory |title=Distinguished Professors |publisher=msstate.edu |accessdate=May 14, 2017}}</ref>

Shivaji completed his undergraduate studies, earning a Special Degree in Mathematics from the [[University of Peradeniya]], Sri Lanka, in 1977 with a first-class honors. He obtained his PhD in Mathematics from Heriot- Watt University in Edinburgh, Scotland, in 1981.

He was included in the 2019 class of fellows of the [[American Mathematical Society]] "for contributions to the theory of semipositone elliptic questions applied to reaction-diffusion systems, for mentoring, and for providing leadership for the inception of a doctoral program in mathematics".<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/profession/ams-fellows/new-fellows|title=2019 Class of the Fellows of the AMS|publisher=[[American Mathematical Society]]|accessdate=2018-11-07}}</ref>

He received the 2024 Conference of Southern Graduate Schools Outstanding Mentor Award<ref>{{Cite web |title=Faculty Award Recipients |url=https://www.csgs.org/past-faculty-award-recipients |access-date=2026-06-29 |website=Csgs |language=en}}</ref> and the 2020 Mathematical Association of America Southeastern Section Distinguished Teaching Award<ref>{{Cite web |last=Vetter |first=Sarah |date=2020-03-30 |title=Shivaji Receives 2020 MAA Southeastern Section Distinguished Teaching Award |url=https://ngwpmathstats.wpengine.com/shivaji-receives-2020-maa-southeastern-section-distinguished-teaching-award/ |access-date=2026-06-29 |website=Mathematics & Statistics |language=en-US}}</ref>.
